scenario.summary: Guest empties the cart, opens a configurable product with radio add-ons, picks the variant by attributes, selects one radio add-on, adds to cart and verifies the line item lists the variant attributes and the add-on.
steps: Search the configurable parent SKU and open it
Select the variant's Bulb Size, Color and Technology
Select the radio add-on (AddOnFirstProduct row, radio column)
Add to Cart and open the cart
stateChanges: Guest cart emptied, then the variant with a radio add-on is added
assertions: Line item description equals the three attribute lines and 'Radio : <add-on>'
evidence: Method name: configurable product with a radio add-on on the cart. Independent method (priority 50, no dependsOn). Same params as the Playwright configurable cart-headers entry (RadioButton).

Read by the page object, not scanned: ProductDisplayPage.selectConfigurableAttributes(pdpDataMap, <variant column>) reads rows ProductSize, ProductColor and Technology of the variant's column -> product.variant1Attr1 (BulbSize), variant1Attr2 (Color), variant1Attr3 (Technology) (order of variantAttributes). No source entries: the cells are not in the scan and the workbook is not read.

Read by the page object, not scanned: ProductDisplayPage.selectAddOnOption(pdpDataMap, 'AddOnFirstProduct') reads row AddOnFirstProduct, column ConfigurableProductWithAddOnAsRadio, and clicks the radio add-on by that name -> product.addOnName (drafted output). The literal row key 'AddOnFirstProduct' is config.
AddOnConfigurableProduct is composed: the three attribute lines then '<addOnGroupName> : <addOnName>'; data without output.
Profile: b-100003 is an active ConfigurableProduct in PRODUCTION (Playwright observations); z-2510011 not profiled.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
